tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground and card fill. The default background for everything.

tokens.name: surface-secondary
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands, hover fill on outline buttons, input wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers and accordion panels that sit on `surface-secondary`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on `surface`, `surface-secondary`, `surface-raised` and `accent`.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Paragraph copy and secondary labels on `surface` and `surface-secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, disabled labels. Light value is the source's own and reads 2.4:1 on `surface`, below 4.5:1, so never use it for text a person must read.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only: it does not reach 3:1, so controls take `border-control`.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs and the outline button, where the edge marks a control. 3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary call to action (Sign up now, Create your own AI).

tokens.name: cta-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of `cta` buttons.

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Label on `cta` and `cta-hover`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Yelvo yellow, the logo colour. Fills only: the logo dot's bars, highlight blocks, the accent button, selected chips. It reads 1.4:1 on white, so never use it for text, icons or rings on light grounds. Labels on it are `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent coloured words, links, step numerals and accent icons. Ochre in light (6.1:1 on `surface`, 5.8:1 on `surface-secondary`), yellow in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover`.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Butter. Soft highlight panels, avatar discs, selected rows.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-soft` and `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Faint wash behind accent badges.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of `accent` buttons and blocks. Labels on it are `on-accent`.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px, solid, every surface. Ochre on light grounds, yellow on dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive outlines on `surface`. Always paired with an icon and a word, since it sits near `accent` in hue.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations (Connected, Saved) on `surface`. Pair with a check icon.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page, hero only, desktop.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Hero and lead section titles. Drops to 30px / 1.2 below 640px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and step titles at large sizes.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Anyone can get set up, no coding required.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under h1 and h2, in `body`.

styles.name: body

styles.name: micro

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Margin annotations and step numerals (01, 02, 03). Never body copy.
